sections.title: PROJECT GOALS
paragraphs: A more cohesive user experience through a single application interface
Integrated one-stop-shopping with the ability to search for a product across all catalogs, including Central Stores
Greater transparency throughout procure-to-pay cycle, including new online sourcing functionality
More precise reporting focused on procurement transactions
Greater visibility into activity through enhanced workflow engines and electronic forms that allow easy management of activities

sections.title: Methodology: Key Objectives
paragraphs: Establish customer “buy in” early in the process
Accelerate Learning, Failure, and the Realization of Value
